note: Issue 442, patrons.md sections 3 and 4, policy.md sections 3 and 8. A patron whose resource specialty was rolled with the other bonus - more of his kind - offers it once he thinks well enough of the PC and something that makes the kind stands somewhere in the colony (a plantation for sugar, a distillery for rum, nothing for wood). Accepted, it is a policy: every town yields more of the kind, and for a processed kind its conversions make more. The PC answers with a share of its charge, all, half or none; a policy of his still standing when he sails is the colony's for good. 90 a month is a placeholder. Placeholder prose.

body.text: I know a good deal about {param:resource}, rather more than a gentleman is supposed to. I have men who know more still.
I could send them out to you. Every town of yours that makes {param:resource} would make more of it, and the methods would stay after the men had gone home.
It would want paying for, month by month, while they are about it. I should like the Crown to meet that.
It would want paying for. I say so now so that you cannot say later I did not.

options.label: accept, and the Crown bears the charge
options.text: Send them, and let the Crown bear the whole of the charge. I would not have you out of pocket for a kindness to my colony.

options.label: accept, and the Crown bears half
options.text: Send them, and the Crown will meet half the charge. I will not pretend that is generous.

options.label: accept, and leave the charge to him
options.text: Send them, and I must leave the charge of it with you. The Crown has nothing to put towards it this year, and I would rather say so than pretend.

options.label: decline, with thanks
options.text: I must decline, and I am sorry to. The Crown has no room for another charge this year.
